summary: BW LPG Limited, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the successful placement of USD 300 million senior unsecured convertible bonds due 2031. The bonds carry a 2.25% coupon, are issued at par in USD 200,000 denominations, and have an initial conversion price of USD 30.4870 per share, reflecting a 40% conversion premium over the reference share price. Proceeds will partly finance a newbuild program for eight Panamax VLGCs and general corporate purposes. A concurrent delta placement of existing shares was conducted by the placement agent to hedge subscriber market risk; the company received no proceeds from that placement. The bonds include dividend protection adjustments and company redemption options. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
